'''''Star Wars Zero Company''''' is a [[canon]] single-player [[Wikipedia:Turn-based tactics|turn-based tactics]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] that takes place during the [[Clone Wars]]. The game is developed by [[Bit Reactor]] in collaboration with [[Electronic Arts]]'s [[Respawn Entertainment]] and published by EA and [[Lucasfilm Games]], and  was released on [[August 27]], [[2026]].
